source_refs.note: ii) Suffix: a main subheading of 19.4 Nomenclature of Aliphatic Organic Compounds, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 41-41.

blocks.text: There are two types of suffixes:

items: Primary suffix, also called suffix of stem or root. It indicates whether the parent chain is saturated or unsaturated.
Secondary suffix, also called suffix of the key functional group. It gives family name of the compound.
